title: Research: X54 mixed-T37 saturation — exhaustive local sweeps, exact Φ packing invariant and width/Φ prices (no new kappa)
body:
**No new κ.** Scoped negative result and screening tool for the X54 mixed-T37 line (#1193/#1218, κ = 0.001675809683500501). Package: `research/x54-mixed-t37-saturation/`.

**Superseded in part during this session:** #1274's helper-donor kernel found a local gain outside the #1186 move families. #1252/#1268/#1280's idle-axis exchanges (48+48 → 45+51) work outside the bin-remainder model used in (2). The README says exactly what still holds.

## Results
1. **Exhaustive local sweeps on both final words (D3 = #1207 BASE-X54, D4 = #1193 FOUR-WORD), #1186 toolkit unchanged, exact frame pricing.** #1195 swept only the pre-X54 words. Results per word:
   - fusion + repair (`repair.py`): 2,238 candidates, 969 feasible, **0 gains**;
   - read-set exchange (all subsets of swappable reads, 14 copy pairs): 50 candidates, 0 feasible;
   - joint triangle-hybrid (≤3 fused reads, partial swaps, both restore modes): 161 candidates, 24 feasible, **0 gains**.

   The baseline frames are exactly optimal.
2. **Exact width-class invariant (stdlib).** Put φ(4) = φ(8) = 0, φ(5) = 3, φ(7) = 1, φ(9) = −1. A full bin of capacity 8, 16 or 32 has Φ ≥ 0, and a full capacity-48 bin has Φ ≥ −4. The 125 D3 / 208 D4 inventory has Φ = −20,814, which is tight. So the two leftover rank-one idle units cannot be merged into one rank-two child, even with time windows, ports and family rules relaxed. That rules out the only cheaper idle histogram in the bin-remainder model (a gain of about +3.3e-10).
3. **ILP screening (SciPy/HiGHS) over demotion-count mixes k ∈ [−3, 3] and all 1,163 bin patterns.** The integer optimum equals the incumbent. The LP duals have the exact form π_w = −λ·w − μ·φ(w), with λ = 11.73 and μ = 25.04. This gives a **screening rule for proposed inventory changes**: an extra entrance group is break-even (which is why the mix stops at 208), 9→8 earns 13.3, 4→5 earns 86.9, and Δκ ≈ −1.03e-11 × score.

## Reproduce
```sh
python3 -B research/x54-mixed-t37-saturation/verify.py      # ~2 s, stdlib: pins, exact lemma vs PACKING.json, 5 rejected controls, sweep tallies
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/x54-mixed-t37-saturation
python3 -B research/x54-mixed-t37-saturation/aggregate.py --out /tmp/agg.json   # SciPy, ~25 s
python3 -B research/x54-mixed-t37-saturation/sweep.py --toolkit <#1186>/research/exact-frame-toolkit --word D3 --out /tmp/s   # ~10 min/word
```
Package hook: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE … outcome=negative-result`. `tests/test_research_*.py` passes (20 tests).

**Not run or not covered:**
- `verify.py` does not rerun the sweeps or the ILP.
- No native or strict admission was needed, since no candidate was found.
- The inherited all-size compiler, realization, hosting, precision/tape, analytic-transfer and bit H1–H5 conditions remain.
